properties.name: containsMessage
properties.label: contains message
properties.comment: Links an Interchange Envelope to its contained Messages.

properties.name: hasSegment
properties.label: has segment
properties.comment: Links a Message to its Segments.

properties.name: hasCompositeElement
properties.label: has composite element
properties.comment: Links a Segment to its Composite Data Elements.

properties.name: hasSimpleElement
properties.label: has simple element
properties.comment: Links a Composite Data Element to its Simple Data Elements.

properties.name: playsRole
properties.label: plays role
properties.comment: Links an Organization to its Agent Role assignment in an Invoice context (reified).

properties.name: involvesRole
properties.label: involves role
properties.comment: Specifies the Agent Role involved in the Organization's participation in the Invoice.

properties.name: inInvoice
properties.label: in invoice
properties.comment: Specifies the Invoice Message in which the Organization plays a Role.

properties.name: hasAddress
properties.label: has address
properties.comment: Links an Organization to its Addresses.

properties.name: hasGLN
properties.label: has GLN
properties.comment: Global Location Number for the Organization.

properties.name: hasItem
properties.label: has item
properties.comment: Links an Invoice Message to its Items.

properties.name: hasPrice
properties.label: has price
properties.comment: Links an Item to its Price.

properties.name: documentDate
properties.label: document date
properties.comment: Date of the invoice as string (due to OWL2 DL datatype restriction).

properties.name: assignedToProcess
properties.label: assigned to process
properties.comment: Assigns the invoice to a business process.

cq_coverage.1: InvoiceMessage is linked to Message via containsMessage; InvoiceMessage instances are listed in a given Message.
cq_coverage.2: Organization is linked to InvoiceMessage via UserResourceUsage (pivot class); organizations involved are those with a playsRole link to a UserResourceUsage in that Invoice.
cq_coverage.3: Organization playsRole UserResourceUsage, which involvesRole AgentRole in a specific InvoiceMessage (via inInvoice); thus, the role of org S is found via its UserResourceUsage in the invoice.
cq_coverage.4: AgentRole (with roleType 'Buyer') linked via UserResourceUsage to Organization and InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.5: Organization has properties hasAddress, hasGLN, and is linked to AgentRole; information about organizations is modeled via these properties and roles.
cq_coverage.6: Buyer is determined via UserResourceUsage with involvesRole Buyer; the address is linked via hasAddress from Organization.
cq_coverage.7: InvoiceMessage hasItem Item; all items sold are those linked to the InvoiceMessage via hasItem.
cq_coverage.8: Item has properties hasPrice, quantity, and is linked to Price; item information is modeled via these properties.
cq_coverage.9: Price is linked to Item via hasPrice; netPrice is a data property of Price.
cq_coverage.10: InvoiceMessage has documentDate, referenceNumber, totalAmount, invoiceNumber, and is linked to Items; invoice details are captured by these properties.
cq_coverage.11: totalAmount is a data property of InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.12: invoiceNumber is a data property of InvoiceMessage.
cq_coverage.13: Mandatory properties (e.g., invoiceNumber, totalAmount, referenceNumber, documentDate, hasItem, hasPrice, hasGLN) are modeled as functional or required data/object properties; SHACL constraints (not in OWL) would validate completeness.
cq_coverage.14: assignedToProcess links InvoiceMessage to BusinessProcess, allowing assignment to a business process.

notes: Ontology plan and CQ coverage mapping complete. Ready to generate OWL ontology in Turtle.
